title: CIP Safety: Minor Refactoring, Part 2
description:
- Extract Method for multiple message encodings to simplify things for future bug fixes and to reduce copy-paste.
  - dissect_base_format_1_or_2_byte_data
  - dissect_base_format_3_to_250_byte_data
  - dissect_extended_format_1_or_2_byte_data
  - dissect_extended_format_3_to_250_byte_data
- Update naming/comments to match wording in the specification (to make things easier to find)
- Note: There are no functionality changes
